name: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Intermediate Pass)
briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana is a scheme by the Bihar government aimed at promoting girl child education, curbing child marriages, reducing fertility rates, and empowering girls to become self-reliant.
descriptionMd: The &quot;Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana&quot;, a component of the &quot;Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana&quot;, launched by the Education Department, Bihar, focuses on the socio-economic upliftment of girls in Bihar. The scheme provides monetary incentives to unmarried girls who have cleared their intermediate examinations from recognized schools or madrasas within Bihar.
benefitsMd:
- **Financial Assistance:** ₹10,000/- for girls passing intermediate in 2021; ₹25,000/- in 2022 and later.
<br>
eligibilityMd:
- The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be an unmarried girl.
- She must have passed the intermediate examination from a recognized school, madrasa, or institution in Bihar.
- The examination must have been conducted in 2021 or later.
- The applicant must have a valid bank account.
applicationMd:
> **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the Registration [page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/Default.aspx). **Step 2:** Scroll down below and click on "Students Click Here To Apply". **Step 3:** Read the instructions and click on the check-boxes. Click on "Continue". **Step 4:** Enter all the mandatory details and create a new password. Validate the Captcha code. **Step 5:** Click on “Submit” to generate the login ID and Password. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the Login [page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/Login.aspx). **Step 2:** Enter all the mandatory details and upload all the required documents. **Step 3:** Recheck all entries before final submission, no modifications can be made in the application after final submission. **Step 4:** Click on “Submit” and take a printout of a copy of the submitted application. > **Check application Details:** Click [Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/StudentStatus.aspx). > **Payment Done Information:** Click [Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/medhamat2022/(S(isowffkahr0cb41idfmeymls))/PaymentDoneList.aspx).
